disclosures.monitor_display: the Phase 1b `status` command listed the slot that was still running (an attempt not yet recorded) under 'failed:'. This was display-only: `run` evaluates slot states only at start-up, and the log shows 9 attempts, 9 launch records, no rerun and no stop. The frozen Phase 1b files are not changed; the Phase 2 monitor reports running and post-processing slots separately
disclosures.trace_overhead: H is computed on traced B launches; tracing perturbs timing (EXP-024), so H's denominator is traced decode time
disclosures.units: H = sum of H_layer (ms) / sum of predicted_ms of the same 8 launches, the PROTOCOL_1B operational choice fixed before acquisition. The frozen ENDPOINTS wording (sum of H_layer / decode tokens as a fraction of mean decode ms/token, with decode ms/token = predicted_ms / predicted_n and 511 decode graphs per launch) equals this H x 512/511 = 0.0845725814; reported for completeness (every H value computed in R5 is reported); the classification is the same under both readings and H is not recomputed for any decision
disclosures.v5_comparator: G1 baseline fidelity used the reconstructed llama-research-v5 comparator (not byte-identical to the lost original); this does not enter H, which uses only the frozen R5 binary

interpretation: H is an optimistic, loose upper bound on the expert-transfer wait that moving the wait could hide (it ignores interference, and W spans to the layer's last expert node). It is an opening gate only: it is NOT an achieved, measured or achievable runtime improvement, and it is never reported as one (R5-00 anti_rescue). PASS only permits Phase 2 to be prepared and opened by its own separate, explicitly authorized step.
scope: development prompts only; evaluation LOCKED; no Phase 2 artifact; no timing contrast between arms
